verdict: MEDIUM overall (no secrets, no SQL/dependency/network/exec change, no auth bypass, no unapproved/duplicate path via any exception injected after the POST). One conditional HIGH remains: outcome classification can still call a money-moved 200 'failed' (release + re-instructable) on falsy/placeholder ErrorMessage or negated-fail-word Status; RS3A-1..7 otherwise closed or reduced to low/info.

findings.severity: high (conditional on real Investec 200 shape; human re-approval still required for a duplicate)
findings.issue: After the POST, 'failed' (release=True, not duplicate-guarded) is still derived from loose substring/truthiness tests, so a 200 that moved money can be released and re-instructed. Entry/data ErrorMessage of False, 0, [], {}, 'None', 'null', 'N/A', 'OK', 'no error', 'false' (any non-blank str() or non-str value) => failed; entry Status containing a fail word as a substring ('Processed - no errors', 'processed without error', 'Not declined') => failed even with a PaymentReferenceNumber present. A re-sent identical instruction then reaches awaiting_approval (guard excludes failed) => second payment possible, daily reservation freed. RS3A-1 itself (ErrorMessage '' / {} / None / non-dict body) IS closed: '' => executed, shapes => needs_review.
findings.fix: Treat only non-empty STRING ErrorMessage as an error and ignore falsy/placeholder values; use needs_review (keep reservation, guard-blocked) whenever a failure indication co-occurs with a PaymentReferenceNumber or a success-looking status, and reserve 'failed'+release for PaymentRejected 4xx or an explicit error with no reference. Match status fail words as whole words with a negation check, else unknown.
findings.repro: Env(live=True); responder=lambda:{'data':{'TransferResponses':[{'PaymentReferenceNumber':'PR1','Status':'Processed'}],'ErrorMessage':False}} -> status failed reserved=False; second identical instruction 60 min later -> awaiting_approval (not possible_duplicate). Same for Status 'Processed - no errors'. scratch: scratchpad/a/ex.py, dup.py, oc.py

findings.issue: Status 'Pending'/'awaiting settlement'/'Pending processing' (payment accepted, in flight) maps to needs_authorisation with release=True: reservation freed (daily cap can be re-used while money is moving). Duplicate guard still blocks re-instruction for 7 days (needs_authorisation is guarded), so no duplicate, but the daily cap is understated.
findings.fix: Only map explicit authorisation wording (authori[sz]) to needs_authorisation+release; 'pending/awaiting' without authorisation => unknown/needs_review (keep reservation).
findings.repro: responder returns Status 'Pending' -> status needs_authorisation reserved=False.
